_note: Phone App events. Same format as v0.1 events.json, without everyDays (that is in common.json). skipIf ids are from upgrades/app.json.

events.text: {brand} is App of the Day in {region}!
Too many users at once! The {brand} servers crash and people are angry.
events.skipText: Millions of new users join {brand} at once, but your cloud servers handle it easily.

events.text: A bug sends the same message 1000 times. Oops. Fixing it costs $40k.
events.skipText: Your beta testers find a nasty bug before anyone else sees it. Nice save!

events.text: News report: is {brand} safe for your data? Some users delete the app.
events.skipText: News report asks if apps are safe. {brand} users feel fine, thanks to Privacy Mode.

events.text: {region} blocks {brand} for a while because it is not in the local language.
events.skipText: {region} checks all foreign apps. {brand} speaks the local language, so it stays.

headlines: Grandma learns to send emojis. Family group chat will never be the same.
Phone battery lasts a full day. Scientists are amazed.
Survey: most people have 80 apps but use 9.
Man drops phone in soup. Phone fine. Soup ruined.
New app counts how many apps you have. It is very popular.
